title: Find and Install an App
drDigitalIntro:
Time to put your app skills together!
• Browse the App Market, find an app, and install it.
• Update an app that needs it.
• Clean up an app you no longer use.
• You know how to do all of this — let's go!

playgroundTask.goal: You searched, installed, updated, and deleted apps

steps.say: Open NoteMaster to read its details.
Go to My Apps to see your installed apps.
WeatherNow has an update available — update it.
Delete SketchPad — you have a different drawing app you prefer.

drDigitalSuccess:
You browsed, installed, updated, and deleted apps like a pro!

Now for real: open your device's app store and find an app that might be useful — maybe a recipe app, a weather app, or a notes app.
drDigitalHint: Use the category tabs to browse, My Apps to manage installed apps, and the trash icon to delete ones you no longer need.
